name: grok
description: Grok CLI agent. Uses the headless mode for safe execution.
capabilities: Headless task run with captured JSON output

headless.flag_notes: Uses --single for headless output and --output-format json for parsing. permission-mode handles safety.

handoff_guidance: REQUIRES the grok CLI binary on PATH (set cmd_bin). Confirm it resolves before enabling.
Default to --permission-mode plan (read-only, captured JSON, reversible).
auto mode can write/run unsupervised - only inside an approved workspace behind a human-approved handoff.
Capture stdout (--output-format json), summarize in Pip's voice, text the result - like the opencode bridge.
